cycle.note: Gold made a base near $4,000 in June and July, rallied 13% in August, then broke back below that base. That means either a second leg down inside phase 4 or a new capitulation (phase 5) that is not confirmed yet.

signals.name: Real yields (10-year)
signals.watch: The yield failing to make a new high, or starting to fall. Analysts such as BCA Research call a peak here the marker of a gold bottom.
signals.reading: The 10-year real yield was 2.79% on 2026-11-24. Its 20-day high is 2.92%, and it moved -0.10 points over the last 5 trading days.

signals.name: US dollar
signals.watch: The dollar rolling over, as it did briefly after the US midterm elections.
signals.reading: The broad US dollar index was 123.6 on 2026-11-20, 0.0% below its 20-day high and +0.8% over the last 5 trading days.

signals.name: Fed rate path
signals.watch: The tone after the Dec 9 decision. Any hint that hikes are ending or pausing would ease the pressure.
signals.reading: A hike on Dec 9 is priced at about 98%. Core PCE rose 0.3% for a third month and 3.3% over the year on Nov 25, and Q3 GDP was revised up to 4.3%. Futures put roughly 57 to 60% on another hike at the Jan 27 meeting. The effective fed funds rate was 3.88% on 2026-11-24.

signals.name: China and central banks
signals.watch: The next monthly China reserve release and the World Gold Council's central bank data. Steady buying acts as a floor under the price.
signals.reading: China's central bank added about 20 tonnes in July, its biggest month since October 2023, and central banks bought roughly 289 tonnes in Q2. No newer China figure has been checked yet.

signals.name: Gold ETF flows
signals.watch: Several weeks in a row of net inflows in the World Gold Council data.
signals.reading: ETFs lost $1.21 billion in the week to Oct 23. July had brought $3 billion of inflows, ending two months of outflows.

signals.name: Speculative positioning
signals.watch: Futures longs flushed out and the options skew moving back toward calls.
signals.reading: The World Gold Council says speculative positions still need further clearing. Options traders are paying less for call protection relative to puts.

signals.name: Stock market stress
signals.watch: Stocks stabilising. Forced selling usually fades with them.
signals.reading: Stocks were lower again before the open on Nov 25 and the VIX was near 31, up from 26 the day before. Asian shares had their worst week since 2020 on Nov 20, and forced selling pulled gold down with stocks.

signals.name: Price levels
signals.watch: A move back above the broken $4,000 area would be the first sign the downtrend is ending.
signals.reading: Gold last closed at $3,678 on 2026-11-27. The 20-day average is $3,854 and the 50-day average is $4,050. That is 34% below the record near $5,600. Source: xaus.com spot gold.

fedgauge.label: Hike pricing easing
fedgauge.reading: The 2-year Treasury yield was 4.63% on 2026-11-24 and the effective fed funds rate was 3.88% on 2026-11-24. The gap is +0.75 points. That is about 3 quarter-point hikes priced in over the next two years. The 2-year yield is 0.25 points below its 20-day high and moved -0.17 over the last 5 trading days.

fedwatch.source: Fed funds futures (RateWatch), after the Nov 25 PCE release

blowoff.label: Not present
blowoff.reading: Gold closed at $3,678 on 2026-11-27, 16.7% below its 200-day average of $4,416. 0 of 3 blow-off conditions are met.

checks.label: Gain over the last 20 trading days
Days up 3% or more, of the last 10

events.headline: Core PCE rises 3.3% over the year, above the 3.2% forecast
events.note: Core was 0.3% for the month, the third month in a row at that pace. Headline PCE was 3.8%, as expected. Q3 GDP was revised up to 4.3%. December hike odds stayed near 98%.

events.headline: Gold falls below $3,500 to about $3,469
events.note: Down about 2% on the day as strong growth and sticky inflation reinforced hike bets. Kitco names $3,431 and $3,400 as the next supports.

events.headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO and gold rebounds to about $3,650
events.note: Tech stocks rallied and forced selling eased for a day. The Fed hike path did not change, and gold gave the bounce back within two days.

events.headline: Fed decision, a hike is widely expected
events.note: A December hike is close to fully priced in. The tone of the statement and press conference matters more than the move itself.

events.headline: Gold hits $3,513, the lowest since September 2025
events.note: Worst week in eight months, down about 9%. Silver, copper, stocks and crypto fell too.

events.headline: Asian shares head for their worst week since 2020
events.note: Forced selling is spreading across assets, and investors are selling gold to raise cash.

events.headline: Fed October minutes point to more rate hikes
events.note: The dollar reached a near 19-month high. Governor Waller said the Fed must respond more aggressively to inflation.

events.headline: 10-year real yield reaches 2.88%
events.note: Up from 2.66% on Nov 9.

events.headline: Waller backs a December rate hike
events.note: In a London speech he backed a 25 basis point hike. Yahoo Finance reports he has since argued for a larger one.

events.headline: October US consumer prices rise 0.4% for the month
events.note: A hot inflation print that strengthened hike expectations.

events.headline: China gold jewelry demand falls 33.9% over nine months
events.note: Year on year for the first nine months of 2026, per Xinhua as reported in early November.

events.headline: Gold bounces about 7% after US midterm results weaken the dollar
events.note: Reached about $4,136. The bounce faded within two weeks.

events.headline: Gold drops about 3.5% in one day as the Nasdaq falls 2.9%
events.note: A sign of forced selling: gold sold to cover losses elsewhere.

events.headline: Fed holds rates on a 10 to 2 vote but leaves the door open to tightening
events.note: Markets then began pricing a December hike.

events.headline: Gold ETFs lose $1.21 billion in a week
events.note: World Gold Council data for the week to Oct 23.

events.headline: Gold breaks below $4,000
events.note: A widely watched support level.

events.headline: Gold falls 4% as the 30-year Treasury yield hits a 24-year high
events.note: Spot reached about $4,111 intraday, then recovered 1.6% the next day.

events.headline: Gold ends August up 13% at $4,563
events.note: The third-best month in 25 years, per the World Gold Council.

events.headline: China adds about 20 tonnes of gold in July
events.note: Its biggest monthly purchase since October 2023. Global central banks bought about 289 tonnes in Q2.

events.headline: Weak US jobs data cools rate-hike bets
events.note: A surprise contraction in July jobs. Oil also softened, and gold bounced off the $4,000 area.

events.headline: Gold ETFs gain $3 billion in July
events.note: Ended two straight months of outflows, per the World Gold Council.

events.headline: Gold hits its 2026 low of about $3,955
events.note: Positioning, sentiment and ETF flows all showed capitulation, a pattern seen at past bottoms. The Nov 20 low went below it.

events.headline: Kevin Warsh becomes Fed chair
events.note: His early signals leaned slightly hawkish, which removed a support gold had enjoyed.

events.headline: Late February: the Iran war begins and oil rallies
events.note: Gold fell on liquidity needs and higher rate expectations instead of acting as a safe haven. The exact day was not checked.

events.headline: Gold rebounds 5% after the January crash
events.note: Back to about $4,913, helped by short covering and $4.4 billion of ETF inflows.

events.headline: Crash day: gold falls about 11% and silver about 31%
events.note: Trump named Kevin Warsh as the next Fed chair. The dollar jumped and CME had raised margin requirements several times in nine days, forcing leveraged sellers out.

events.headline: Gold sets its record near $5,600
events.note: The end of a parabolic run. Gold had gained nearly 65% in 2025.
